connect.title: Connect GitHub to review pull requests
connect.body: Reviews use the installed GitHub App: choose the repositories in Integrations.

repo.description: Each commit is compared with its target branch: only what the PR introduces counts.
repo.post_comment: Comment and set the commit status on GitHub
repo.branch: Rescan the target branches when they change
repo.admin_only: Only an administrator can change these settings.
repo.enable_hint: Not watched: turn it on in the list, or review a PR by hand.
repo.branch_pending: Target branches will be scanned on the watcher's next pass.
repo.missing_write: The GitHub App can't comment yet: it needs write access to Pull requests and Commit statuses. Reviews still show up here.
repo.help_status: Findings join the repository's status and are marked fixed when a later commit removes them or the PR closes without merging.
repo.help_branches: After a merge, each target branch is scanned again at most once every {{minutes}} min.
repo.help_rescan: Re-scan reviews the PR's latest commit again, for example after changing a policy.

list.title: Open pull requests
list.empty: No open pull requests in this repository.

watch.title: Watched repositories · {{total}}
watch.description: Watched repositories review every PR push on their own (checked every {{minutes}} min).
watch.member_hint: Only an admin changes what's watched.
watch.confirm_all: Watch every repository in the GitHub App? Each push to any of them will trigger a review.
watch.partial: Partial results: this account's repository list is still being read from GitHub.
watch.branch_current: target branches kept up to date

targets.title: Target branches
targets.description: Only PRs into these branches are reviewed.
targets.invalid: "{{branch}}" isn't a valid branch name. Use letters, digits and . _ / -, without spaces or "..".
